# HR Technology Architecture & Data Flow

| Layer | Required capability | Control point |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workforce master | Employee, position, organisation, site, contract and payroll-rule data | Unique identity, effective dates, transfer history and tenant isolation |
| AI layer | Job-description drafting, resume extraction, screening assistance and HR summaries | Bias testing, explainability, confidence thresholds and human review |
| Workflow layer | Recruitment, onboarding, attendance exceptions, approvals and payroll closing | Role permissions, separation of duties and versioned rules |
| Attendance layer | Mobile, site, shift, overtime, leave and exception capture | Necessity, minimisation, alternative verification and device controls |
| Payroll layer | Salary components, tax, social insurance and regional rules | Effective-date versioning, reconciliation and payslip auditability |
| Integration layer | Finance, ERP, identity, devices and local statutory systems | API authentication, field mapping, retry and reconciliation |
